official_references.claim: Direct API standard Alimtalk price is 13 KRW per message excluding VAT; ordinary base API access has no monthly base charge. Extra products and usage conditions may add charges.
Business Kakao channel linkage and approved templates are prerequisites for Alimtalk sending. SMS fallback is separately priced.

The reference architecture uses a 12 USD/month Linux IPv4 app server and a 30 USD/month standard managed database with encryption. Backup and storage are additional. The proposal's 60,000-100,000 KRW monthly range is our planning estimate, not a fixed AWS bill. The 15 USD standard database lacks encryption and is not the assumed configuration.

The recent merchant guide states card review can take up to 10-14 business days after contract completion, with possible delays. Real products, prices, business information, policies and a functioning checkout path are reviewed.
A different selling business requires a new merchant contract. One shared website or brand does not establish that two stores can share a merchant account.
Browser authentication and the success redirect must be followed by server-side validation and approval. The order amount, order identifier and payment identifier must be validated/persisted.
Use transaction verification, idempotency and verified status notifications or payment lookup to prevent duplicate and forged completion.
Full and partial cancellations, timing and refund requirements differ by payment method. Sending a cancellation request must not be presented as a completed refund before checking its outcome.
Payout services for marketplace sellers involve separate application/contract and seller risk checks; they are outside this direct-merchant baseline.
PG onboarding/annual charges, transaction fees and applicable guarantee conditions must be confirmed under the actual merchant contract. They are not included in our development budget.

PortOne is not assumed in the baseline. Its current public free tier is below 50 million KRW monthly net volume; the next tier costs 100,000 KRW/month excluding VAT. Merchant onboarding and card review remain separate.
Alcohol smart-order pickup has specific conditions. Alcohol online sales are not treated as automatically included in the food-only payment baseline.

estimates_not_vendor_quotes.pg_prerequisite: Takeout module already delivered; one selling business, one PG, one merchant account; hosted authenticated checkout, domestic card and contracted wallet methods, full cancellation only.

naver.recommendation: Keep Naver Place discovery while centralizing group-room inventory. If keeping Naver Booking, segregate inventory or promptly register/block manually. Do not promise live two-way synchronization without official eligibility verification.

portfolio.john: The source profile says web service built, mobile expansion ongoing. Public songbook search/filter/list screenshot captured through the approved browser UI; only a contact-free pixel crop is embedded.
portfolio.agricultural_order_ai: Started November 2026 and still in development. It is workflow/automation evidence, not a claim of completed restaurant reservations, payment processing or certified Alimtalk integration.
